name: Shut Up And Take My Money Fry
aka: Shut Up and Take My Money
look: A still from Futurama. Fry, with spiky orange hair, a red jacket and a white T-shirt, scowls and shouts while thrusting a fistful of green dollar bills toward the viewer.
use: Expresses overwhelming eagerness to buy something. The top caption describes a product or deal that sounds amazing, and the bottom is Fry's impatient 'Shut up and take my money!'
slots: top caption: the irresistible product or offer
bottom caption: usually 'Shut up and take my money!'
examples: A phone charger cable that actually reaches the bed
Shut up and take my money!
Socks that never lose their partner in the wash
Shut up and take my money!
describe: futurama guy shoving cash at you
cartoon man with orange hair holding out a wad of money
fry yelling while waving dollar bills
redhead in a red jacket desperate to buy something
angry cartoon guy holding money in his fist
origin: From the 2010 Futurama episode 'Attack of the Killer App', where Fry is desperate to buy the new eyePhone.
